data.name: UnderstandingNT2Heading
data.value: Understanding NT2

data.name: UnderstandingNT2Paragraph
data.value: NT2, or 'Nederlands als Tweede Taal', stands for Dutch as a Second Language. It refers to specialized programs designed for those who are not native Dutch speakers but wish to achieve fluency in Dutch. Mastery of the Dutch language is not just a skill—it's a crucial step towards fully integrating into Dutch society, enabling both personal and professional growth.

data.name: HeroTitle
data.value: Learning Dutch without giving up your identity

data.name: HeroDescription
data.value: You're highly educated, motivated, and probably pretty good at learning things — otherwise you wouldn't be here. And yet it can feel like you've been sent back to kindergarten the moment you try to form a Dutch sentence. That's not strange. That's simply what happens when you learn a new language as an adult: relearning how to ride a bike (important in the Netherlands!), except with words this time.

data.name: HeroNoteTitle
data.value: We’re Dominique and Patrick

data.name: HeroNoteDescription
data.value: Dominique is mainly your language trainer, but we've both experienced first-hand what it's like to survive in another country without speaking the language well (enough). That experience runs through everything we do.

data.name: PromiseParagraph
data.value: We won't tell you it'll all just click in three weeks. What we will tell you: with us, it can be a lot more fun, faster, and a lot less lonely. And that you're welcome — encouraged, even — to practise and make as many mistakes as you like with us.

data.name: WhyUsEyebrow
data.value: More than a language course

data.name: WhyUsParagraph1
data.value: We've both lived in other countries without speaking the language. We know what it's like to explain what you need using only hand gestures, to feel intelligent in your own language and completely hopeless in the new one. We use that experience every day — not as an anecdote, but as a compass. We know exactly which mistakes you'll make, because we've made them ourselves, and honestly, sometimes still do (language, by the way, is far from the only thing we've learned through trial and error). But: we enjoy it! And we want that for you too.

data.name: WhyUsParagraph2
data.value: We don't shy away from any topic. With us, you won't just learn textbook Dutch, or the kind of Dutch you hear from a newsreader — you'll learn real Dutch: how it's actually used, what a Dutch person really means (spoiler: often something quite different from what's literally being said), and yes, the nuances, the culture, and the little quirks we're occasionally a bit embarrassed about ourselves. Think of the wonderful world of “de” and “het,” the very precisely-timed 6 PM Dutch dinner, congratulating and kissing EVERYONE at a birthday party, or why we say “gezellig” and “lekker” a hundred times a day while meaning something else half the time. Honesty works better than polite avoidance, and a bit of self-mockery (from both sides) makes learning a lot lighter — and a lot more fun.

data.name: WhyUsParagraph3
data.value: With us, you're not a number in a classroom, and not “a student at a distance.” You're a unique, brave person building a new life, and that calls for a mentor who thinks along with you. About the language, yes, but also about everything else: where the nice spots in the Netherlands are, how on earth that one government agency actually works, and why everyone here seems to have an opinion about your bike, your car, your garden...

data.name: TailoredEyebrow
data.value: For everyone, with any goal

data.name: TailoredTitle
data.value: An approach we tailor to you

data.name: TailoredParagraph1
data.value: Whether you just want to pass the mandatory civic integration exams, truly want to master the language to feel fully at home, or need to pass the mandatory B2+ test for your BIG registration as a healthcare professional — we'll guide you there. Every goal calls for a different approach, and we tailor ours to you.

data.name: TailoredParagraph2
data.value: Want to study independently, at your own pace, whenever suits you — but without being completely on your own? Then our DIY course is probably for you. Much more affordable than a regular course, but with the backup of a real teacher: you're in direct contact with both your teacher and fellow students whenever you get stuck. The best of both worlds — independence and a safety net.

data.name: TailoredParagraph3
data.value: Curious whether this is right for you? Start with the free level test — it'll immediately show you how good your chances are of succeeding with a DIY track.
